title: Amazon to expand Prime Air drone delivery to nearly 500 US cities and towns
summary: Amazon said it will expand Prime Air drone delivery, currently live in about 10 US metro areas, to nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of 2026, adding Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta and Boise.

title: Google and Marvell expand custom AI silicon deal, Google gets right to buy $12.2B stake
summary: Marvell granted Google warrants to purchase up to $12.2 billion of its shares, tied to Google's purchases of custom silicon for the TPU ecosystem, including AI inference accelerators, networking chips, storage and memory controllers.

title: CISA KEV remediation deadlines: TrueConf Server flaws (CVE-2026-72529, CVE-2026-72530)
summary: CISA added two actively exploited TrueConf Server vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on August 20, 2026; federal agencies must remediate the missing-authentication flaw (CVE-2026-72529) by August 23 and the code-injection flaw (CVE-2026-72530) by September 2.

title: CISA KEV remediation deadline: Windows AFD WinSock zero-day (CVE-2026-68820)
